_note: How hunters, bots and remote players use the stairs, ladders and drops of the continuous levels (hunters/flight_edges.rs). ladder_speed_scale multiplies the climb speed of a ladder (vertical.rs LADDER_CLIMB_SPEED, m/s). drop_allowed lets a hunter jump down a drop (waterfall or hole); one way, off by default. drop_fall_speed is the speed of that fall in m/s. edge_cost_scale (at least 1) multiplies the path cost of a flight, a ladder or a drop. reference_speed is the hunter walk speed in m/s that turns a ladder climb time into a path cost. hear_adjacent_scale is the factor on a sound's radius when it is one storey away (0 = not heard). see_adjacent lets a hunter see a target one storey away through an open well. capture_height is the largest height difference in metres at which a hunter captures. same_layer_eps (0.1 to 2.0) is the largest height difference in metres at which two hunters count as standing at the same height (the director's pairing; also the height band in which a bot is an obstacle to a hunter). edge_enter_radius is how close in metres a hunter must be to the entrance of an edge to start walking it. edge_fit_radius is the body radius in metres of the footprint test while walking an edge (the runner's radius, because the routes of the flights are validated for it; the wider hunter body would stall at the tight turn of a mid landing); it is also the radius of a bot as the director keeps a hunter off it. edge_stuck_seconds is how long a hunter or bot may fail to progress on an edge before it replans. resident_hunter_cap is how many hunters a resident floor beside the active one simulates. search_expansions is the most cells one cross-level path search may expand before it gives up (an empty route). goal_snap_radius is how many cells a goal that stands on a closed cell (a stair tread) moves to the nearest open one. cross_repath_seconds is how often a walker that is crossing levels re-plans its route. follow_cross_seconds is how long a hunter keeps following a target that left its level before it gives up. wander_cross_chance and search_cross_chance (0 to 1) are the chances that a wandering or a searching hunter picks a goal on another level. land_spread (0 to 0.4) is the largest offset in metres from the centre of its landing cell at which a hunter is set down after an edge, so a queue of followers does not stack (clamped to keep the body in the cell; the spot must also be ground a hunter fits, else the cell centre). cross_wander_radius (1 to 256) is how far in cells from a hunter a stair is looked for when it picks a goal on another level. max_point_gap (0.05 to 4, default 0.5) is the longest gap in metres between two points of an edge's route polyline (the long ladder shaft and drop fall are subdivided to it). separation_max_step (0.01 to 1, default 0.15) is the most in metres per frame that the overlap push of the director moves a hunter, from another hunter or from a bot. capture_los_slack (0 to 1, default 0.15) is the distance in metres past the grab reach within which a capture needs no clear line; beyond it a wall, a shut door or a railing refuses the capture. The last three keys may be left out of an older file.
